settings.intro_highlight: Engineered and manufactured in North America to rigorous international standards, the Hot Cabi merges consistent gentle heat distribution with ergonomic practitioner workflows to optimize clinical skincare treatments and client comfort.
settings.custom_description: The Hot Cabi 61101 is purpose-built for licensed professionals, including practicing estheticians, Medical Spa Therapists, and Cosmetic Injectors. Its compact tabletop footprint targets treatment room congestion during back-to-back appointments, enabling sharper focus on service execution and treatment execution. Whether you are performing deep-pore cleansing, microdermabrasion, or post-procedure recovery, this professional station adjusts to your modality-specific positioning with instant-response calibration and seamless operation.
settings.subtitle: Professional Reliability & Precision
settings.secondary_description: Durability is central to the Equipro approach. To preserve the structural integrity and optical cleanliness of Hot Cabi, wipe down surfaces regularly with surface disinfectant formulated for clinical environments weekly. The high-density housing, stainless steel interior, and durable powder-coated exterior resist chemical wear and ambient degradation, ensuring flawless performance across 15 to 20 years of continuous salon use. Consistent care maintains optimal warming efficiency and protects your investment.

settings.heading: Key Features for the Professional Station

settings.text: Position the Hot Cabi unit on a stable, flat surface within your treatment area and connect the power cord to a grounded 110-120V outlet.
Moisten up to 12 facial towels (13" x 24"), wring out excess moisture thoroughly, roll them, and place them on the removable internal rack.
Flip the main switch to activate the heating system; the power indicator light will illuminate during operation.
Retrieve warm towels as needed during treatments, closing the insulated door immediately to maintain internal temperature.
Power off the device upon completion of shift, remove remaining towels, and sanitize exterior and interior touchpoints with a clinical disinfectant wipe.
Never insert soaking wet towels dripping excess water directly into the unit to protect internal electrical components.
Always check towel warmth or use thermal tongs when retrieving items to prevent discomfort.
Operate the device solely within dry indoor treatment rooms, adhering to standard electrical safety protocols.
